headlines.title: 'My mortgage is going up £200': How rising interest rates are hitting people's pockets

headlines.title: Interest rates hiked to 4% in first increase in over three years
headlines.description: Most analysts expected the increase from 3.75% to 4%.

headlines.title: Second buyer makes rescue bid for Poundland as retailer faces collapse

headlines.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
headlines.description: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

headlines.title: Canva announces major job cuts after 'our hardest year yet'
